eventDetail.scope: The Stuttgart Conference on Automotive Production (SCAP) is an international platform hosted at ARENA2036, University of Stuttgart, bringing together academia and industry to advance automotive production, intelligent manufacturing, and digital engineering systems.  SCAP has been successfully held three times (2020 online, 2022 and 2024 in person), attracting strong international participation and establishing itself as a recognized forum in the field. The conferences featured keynotes, peer-reviewed sessions, workshops, and demonstrations, with all accepted papers published as open-access Springer proceedings, ensuring high scientific visibility. The events also demonstrated solid attendance and financial sustainability.  SCAP 2026 will focus on AI and Intelligent Automation in Engineering and Production, aligning strongly with IEEE domains such as AI, robotics, and smart manufacturing.
